summary.headline: Apomasar Chapter Index
summary.text: Catalog of Angelican Codex 2, recording an epistle of Emperor Manuel Komnenos, lunar and solar omens, and the chapter index of the astrological book of Apomasar. Chapters cover mundane effects, solar and lunar eclipses, chronocrators, abundance and scarcity, heatwaves, Mercury’s affliction, the Harranian method, the rising of the Dog Star, and rains, with cross-references to other codices and chapters.
